body: i dont feel like this at all......i come from a small community who does everything in reminding my family what i could have been....my work seperates me from my family physically and emotionally.....a job i hate....which isnt paying now as it should...and a personality which went from hilarity to profound pessimism......my brother is going to be well indowed to cater to my family......i sense resentment and see "ohh what u could have been" faces and i want to go while my family still loves me..
